questions.q: Which is the biggest ocean?
questions.fact: The Pacific Ocean covers about a third of our planet.

questions.q: What do we call land with water all around it?
questions.fact: Hawaii is made up of islands.

questions.q: Where is it snowy and freezing all year long?
questions.fact: Polar bears live in the icy Arctic near the North Pole.

questions.q: What do we call a very tall piece of land?
questions.fact: Some mountains are so tall their tops are covered in snow all year.

questions.q: What is water flowing across land to the sea called?
questions.fact: Many rivers start high up in the mountains.

questions.q: What is a hot, sandy place with very little rain?
questions.fact: Camels can go for days without a drink in the desert.

questions.q: On most maps, what color shows water?
questions.fact: Maps use colors to show what is land and what is water.

questions.q: How many continents are there?
questions.fact: Antarctica is the coldest continent.

questions.q: Which country is just north of the United States?
questions.fact: Canada is the second biggest country in the world.

questions.q: Which flag has red and white stripes and 50 stars?
questions.fact: The stars on the U.S. flag stand for the 50 states.

questions.q: Which country's flag has a red maple leaf?
questions.fact: Canada's maple leaf flag was first raised in 1965.

questions.q: What do we call a huge body of salty water?
questions.fact: The ocean covers most of our planet.

questions.q: Which of these is a big city in the United States?

questions.q: Where would you find the Statue of Liberty?
questions.fact: The Statue of Liberty was a gift from France.

questions.q: What is the capital of the United States?
questions.fact: Washington, D.C. is not inside any state.

questions.q: What is the capital of Canada?
questions.fact: Ottawa sits right on the border between Ontario and Quebec.

questions.q: Which is the largest continent?
questions.fact: More than half of all the people in the world live in Asia.

questions.q: What is the tallest mountain above sea level on Earth?
questions.fact: Mount Everest is on the border of Nepal and China.

questions.q: Which U.S. state is the biggest by area?

questions.q: Which U.S. state is made up of islands?
questions.fact: Hawaii has eight main islands.

questions.q: Which Great Lake is completely inside the United States?
questions.fact: The other four Great Lakes touch both Canada and the United States.

questions.q: What is the world's largest hot desert?
questions.fact: The Sahara is almost as big as the whole United States.

questions.q: Which river carved out the Grand Canyon?
questions.fact: The river cut down through the rock over millions of years.

questions.q: Which ocean lies between North America and Europe?
questions.fact: The Atlantic is the second biggest ocean.

questions.q: Which huge waterfall sits on the border of Canada and the United States?
questions.fact: Niagara Falls is really three waterfalls side by side.

questions.q: Which country is shaped like a boot?
questions.fact: Italy's boot looks like it is kicking the island of Sicily.

questions.q: In which country are the pyramids of Giza?
questions.fact: The Great Pyramid was built more than 4,500 years ago.

questions.q: Which two countries share the world's longest border?
questions.fact: That border is almost nine thousand kilometers long.

questions.q: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.fact: Canberra was built as a brand-new capital so Sydney and Melbourne would not have to compete.

questions.q: Which is the longest mountain range on land?
questions.fact: The Andes stretch along the whole west side of South America.

questions.q: Which country is the biggest in the world by area?
questions.fact: Russia stretches across eleven time zones.

questions.q: Which African river flows through Egypt?
questions.fact: Most people in Egypt live close to the Nile.

questions.q: What is the smallest country in the world?
questions.fact: Vatican City is less than half a square kilometer in size.

questions.q: Which Canadian province is the biggest in area?
questions.fact: Quebec is more than twice as big as France.

questions.q: Which U.S. state has the most people?
questions.fact: More than one in every ten Americans lives in California.

questions.q: Which mountains mark part of the border between Europe and Asia?
questions.fact: The Ural Mountains run north to south through Russia.

questions.q: Which continent is almost completely covered in ice?

questions.q: Which ocean holds the Mariana Trench, the deepest known place on Earth?

questions.q: In which country is the city of Rio de Janeiro?
questions.fact: Rio hosted the Summer Olympic Games in 2016.

questions.q: Which imaginary line divides Earth into the Northern and Southern Hemispheres?
questions.fact: The Equator is about 25,000 miles around.

questions.q: Which Canadian city is home to the CN Tower?
questions.fact: The CN Tower was the tallest free-standing structure in the world for more than thirty years.

questions.q: What is the biggest island in the world that is not a continent?
questions.fact: Most of Greenland is covered by a thick sheet of ice.
